name: Signal Amplifier - First Strike
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's First Strike capability.

61171.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · First Strike
61171.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
On the <color=#F74848>1st</color> active attack per turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
